$comment: Agent loops on the live yardd (see verify/loops/README.md). patrol, maintain and review are yardd automations (Automations page, never the sidebar) built from this file by verify/yv loop automations --apply: rerun it after changing them. Their schedule is in the host's time zone; an interval counts from when it was saved, or aligns to its optional active window start. verify and babysit are manual automations (never fire on their own): verify/yv loop run verify|babysit --pr N saves them when they differ and starts a run with that PR's prompt. Changing this file is a self-or-CI change.

budget.$comment: Skip a run when the engine's usage is above these percentages (5-hour window, week). The automations get them as maxFiveHour and maxWeek; only verify/yv loop run also skips on machine load.
